ios.desc:
Drops is a free iOS app that provides daily wisdom quotes and personal journaling to boost your mental wellbeing. Discover clarity and motivation amidst the modern life chaos with Drops. This personal space is designed to empower you with affirmations, encourage reflection through writing, and support your mental growth through consistent practice. Embrace a clearer, more driven mindset today.

KEY FEATURES: 

- Receive daily quotes from greatest minds worldwide
- Create notes on quotes and journals 
- Explore a vast collection of quotes, sorted by categories and authors
- Customize your experience with different design themes
- Keep track of all your previous quotes and notes
- Set up personalized daily reminders
- Enjoy iOS widgets for quick access to quotes on your screen
- Share inspiring quotes and notes with others anytime

Download Drops for free today! Please also leave us a review or reach out via official@drops.work. 

Privacy Policy: https://www.drops.work/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.drops.work/terms-and-conditions

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I just shipped Drops - an iOS app that offers daily wisdom quotes and personal journaling for mental wellbeing. It is on the App Store now and 100% free.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/drops-daily-motivations/id6444506885

The idea comes from my own interests. Over the past few years, I've come to discover the magic of short, powerful quotes, and how helpful regular reflection can be for my emotions. Therefore, I built this app to help users cultivate positive thinking and live happily and consciously every day.

Feel free to share feedback. Cheers.

Ananda
